name: quorum

scripts.start:cloud: QUORUM_EDITION=cloud vite build && QUORUM_EDITION=cloud node dev-app.cjs
scripts.dev: osascript -e 'if application id "design.smejkal.quorum" is running then quit app id "design.smejkal.quorum"' && sleep 1 && npm start
scripts.db:local: cd .. && supabase start; supabase status -o env | grep -E '^(API_URL|STUDIO_URL|INBUCKET_URL|MAILPIT_URL)'
scripts.db:seed-owner: test -n "$EMAIL" || { echo 'Set EMAIL to the address of an account that has signed in to the local stack'; exit 1; }; docker exec -i supabase_db_quorum psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v email="'$EMAIL'" -f - < ../supabase/seed/platform-owner.sql
scripts.package: vite build && cd ../helper && swift build -c release && cd ../app && electron-builder --mac && node scripts/check-package.mjs
scripts.package:cloud: QUORUM_EDITION=cloud vite build && cd ../helper && swift build -c release && cd ../app && node scripts/package-cloud.mjs

description: Meetings and your second brain, on your Mac

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Quorum transcribes your side of a meeting on this Mac.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Quorum transcribes the other people in a meeting on this Mac.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Quorum turns meeting audio into text on this Mac.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Quorum shows your upcoming meetings on Home.
